data.title: 橘美花莉 · 摄影棚收工的三秒
data.description: 摄影棚白色背景前，闪光灯刚停，她从完美表情切换到松一口气的真实脸只用三秒；工作人员围着看片，她独自拿起水杯，眼神飘向手机里的社团群消息。
data.action: 摄影棚白色背景前，闪光灯刚停，她从完美表情切换到松一口气的真实脸只用三秒
data.promptProse: Mikari is the only model in front of the white sweep. She holds a water cup in one hand and checks her phone with the other. At the remote edge of the studio, a short-haired photographer in a dark polo looks through pictures with a gray-haired assistant in a black headset. Both staff members stay beside the monitor while the studio light picks out Mikari.
